fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld, from the page's single NewsArticle ld+json block, which carries articleBody directly) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-html-listing, homepage-scraped since no working RSS/sitemap exists) carry title/link/articleId-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld, S2-html-listing).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the NewsArticle ld+json block (HTML-entity-unescaped).

description.title: Description
description.description: Article summary/lede, from the NewsArticle ld+json block.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, from the ld+json articleBody field directly (no HTML fallback needed on this site).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-joined auto-generated SEO keyword string from ld+json (the headline's words, not curated topic tags) -- passed through as-is.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name from the ld+json author Person object (often the generic 'Observer Web Team' byline).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher name from the ld+json publisher Organization object.

copyrightHolder.title: Copyright holder
copyrightHolder.description: Copyright holder name from the ld+json copyrightHolder Organization object.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image ImageObject (url/width/height) from ld+json, passed through raw.

inLanguage.title: Language
inLanguage.description: Content language code from ld+json (always 'en' on sampled articles).

url.title: Canonical URL
url.description: The article's true canonical URL from ld+json -- resolved by numeric article ID regardless of what category/slug segments were requested.

urlCategoryPath.title: URL category path
urlCategoryPath.description: Best-effort category/subcategory path segments parsed from the URL (e.g. ['business','energy']) -- not present in upstream ld+json, derived from the URL itself, absent if the URL doesn't match the expected pattern.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode homepage-listing item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL as scraped from the homepage listing.

articleId.title: Article ID
articleId.description: Numeric article ID parsed from the URL -- the only part of the path the server actually uses for routing. Latest-mode items are sorted newest-first by this ID descending.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
